time_contract: Unix seconds in UTC unless an embedded payload states another format. Clinical date-only fields do not imply midnight.
missing_contract: Null means unknown or not applicable. It is never an implicit zero.
source_contract: Health payloads retain provider fields. Unsupported fields are archival evidence, not validated measurements.

manual_domains.journal: Boolean behaviors, numeric measurements with explicit units, local clock times as minutes from midnight, mood and perceived stress. Empty fields remain unknown.
manual_domains.training: Session start and end, paused minutes, explicit duration basis, optional CR10 effort and answer time. Different duration bases do not combine.
manual_domains.training_day: rest or all_sessions_logged, applied only to the recorded local date and timezone.
manual_domains.sleep_correction: Source session and input revisions, user classification and optional estimated minutes. Source intervals remain unchanged.
manual_domains.nutrition: Consumed food with optional macro and micronutrient amounts. Origin retains the selected portion and source snapshot. Missing amounts remain unknown.
manual_domains.body: Weight in kg, optional body fat in percent from 0 to 100, and optional waist in cm.
manual_domains.blood_pressure: Paired systolic and diastolic pressure in mmHg, optional pulse in bpm, arm and posture.
manual_domains.cycle: Observed flow, symptoms and explicit cycle, pregnancy, postpartum or perimenopause context. Entries do not establish ovulation.
manual_domains.breathing: Actual recorded duration in minutes and optional measured breaths per minute.
manual_domains.preferences: Source priorities, favorite metrics and optional sleep goal in minutes, under the separate helpyourself.preferences source.
manual_domains.exercise: Named exercise, equipment, muscle groups, instructions and notes. This library entry does not represent completed activity.
manual_domains.workout_template: Named sequence of exercise prescriptions, sets, repetitions or duration, external weight and rest. Templates do not contribute training load.
manual_domains.planned_workout: Dated workout prescription with planned or skipped status. Completion requires a separate training record.
manual_domains.food: Nutrients per 100 grams, brand, optional barcode and source. Optional external_source retains the reviewed Open Food Facts response and retrieval time.
manual_domains.recipe: Recipe yield and ingredient snapshots with grams, source and nutrients per 100 grams. Missing ingredient nutrients remain unknown.
manual_domains.nutrition_goals: User-defined daily nutrient targets. These are preferences, not clinical treatment targets.
manual_domains.diet_quality: Confirmed full-day food-pattern equivalents for HEI-2020, source and age eligibility. Duplicate dates or incomplete input stop the window score.
manual_domains.meal_plan: Recipe snapshot, planned servings and planned or skipped status. Shopping quantities are grams. Plans do not count as consumed food.
manual_domains.reminder: User-authored recurrence, local date and clock time, optional end date and quiet hours. Local notifications require explicit device scheduling.
manual_domains.memory: User-editable context for archive questions, with an enabled flag. This content is not a verified health observation.
manual_domains.cycle_prediction: External predicted date range, generation time, named source and uncertainty statement. Predictions remain separate from confirmed cycle observations.

source_formats.nn-intervals-v1: Quality-reviewed NN intervals in milliseconds with second offsets, acquisition context, posture, device, firmware and protocol. Gaps and inconsistent durations stop RMSSD.
source_formats.fit: Original base64 bytes, SHA-256 and all decoded messages. Timestamp fields use UTC Unix seconds. Source timer and elapsed durations remain separate.
source_formats.tcx-2: Original UTF-8 XML, SHA-256, source laps and track points. Unmapped extensions remain in the original XML.
source_formats.gpx-1.1: Original UTF-8 XML and SHA-256. Distance uses coordinates within segments. Elapsed duration includes gaps.
